description: This file defines an Android ViewModel (AppListViewModel) that manages and exposes a live data list of app entries which can be launched. It includes internal classes for loading app data asynchronously and for listening to package-related broadcasts to update the list dynamically.

classes.name: AppListViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel providing a live data list of launchable apps, managing app list data and receiver lifecycle.

classes.name: AppListLiveData
classes.description: A LiveData subclass that loads and holds a list of apps asynchronously, updating when the app list changes.

classes.name: PackageIntentReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that listens for package installation, removal, or change events, and triggers data reloads.

methods.name: AppListViewModel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ViewModel with application context, creating LiveData and receiver.

methods.name: getAppList
methods.description: Returns LiveData containing the list of AppEntry objects.

methods.name: onCleared
methods.description: Unregisters the package intent receiver when the ViewModel is cleared.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads app information asynchronously by querying the package manager for launchable apps.

methods.name: PackageIntentReceiver
methods.description: Constructor that registers for package-related broadcasts and external storage events.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles broadcast events by triggering a data reload via the LiveData object.
